posts.hook: An AI just handed mathematicians hundreds of papers to check
posts.caption: openai released 722 math manuscripts from an unreleased model, attackers hijacked three country domains to get fake certificates for google, utah will let ai prescribe medication without human oversight. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: OpenAI releases 722 math manuscripts from an unreleased internal model
slides.desc: Checking the results, not producing them, is now the ==bottleneck==.

slides.title: Attackers hijacked three country domains to mint fake certificates for Google
slides.desc: Chrome now blocks them and the issuers revoked them.

terms.gloss: digital ids that prove a website is really who it claims to be

slides.title: Utah will let AI examine patients and prescribe medication without human oversight
slides.desc: Billed as a first for a US state: autonomy moves into clinics.

slides.title: OpenAI will watermark ChatGPT text by default, but only in the EU
slides.desc: Driven by the EU AI Act; no watermark is reliably tamper-proof yet.

slides.title: SpaceX seeks $40B, mostly debt, to buy Nvidia chips
slides.desc: AI compute is now financed like infrastructure.

posts.hook: You can now check whether that image was made by AI
posts.caption: google opened a public detector for ai watermarks, a suspected shinyhunters leader was reportedly detained, musk says grok bot will borrow rival models. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Google opens a public SynthID Detector for AI-made images, video and audio
slides.desc: It only finds watermarked media, so a clean result ==proves nothing==.

terms.gloss: google's invisible watermark hidden in ai images, audio and video

slides.title: Suspected ShinyHunters leader reportedly detained mid-extortion
slides.desc: Krebs says he is cooperating with the FBI; the PeopleSoft flaw behind the thefts hit dozens of orgs.

terms.gloss: a hacking group that steals company data and demands payment

slides.title: Lawmakers introduce bills to curb Flock after 404 Media coverage
slides.desc: Reporting is turning into statute on police camera networks.

slides.title: Grok Bot will route tasks to Claude Opus 5.5, Midjourney and Suno
slides.desc: Even a model maker is conceding no single model ==wins== every task.
